name: Soyuz-20
about: Soyuz-20 (1975-106A), a crewed vehicle (7K-TA), launched 1975 Nov 17. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1975 Dec 22), held fixed
docked to S07591; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
